note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): methods, paths, auth schemes, paginate, stream and the token rotation rules; the request body conflict, the closed key sets of the request and of every nested object, the auth onUnauthorized and required keys, the origin and tokenUrl against `egress` (default ports, case, path prefixes, ports, IPv6, userinfo, data origins, @config knobs of an unresolved .orb) and the emit block. The collector answer is the HOST_CALLS_COLLECTED the shared collector gives for the same program; the emit-config answer holds the findings Rust reports for each call. The ORB_HTTP_AUTH_INVALID cases compare only the onUnauthorized and required-key messages (the other messages are not ported).
